selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What belief is stated at the beginning of the passage about Allah?
questions.answer: That only Allah is worthy of worship, and He is the One and Only.

questions.question: Which names for the Prophet show his high rank among people?
questions.answer: He is described as the pride of the world and the honor of the children of Adam.

questions.question: What makes the Prophet stand out in the passage above other people?
questions.answer: His Qur’an, religion, virtues, character, miracles, and the support of righteous people.

questions.question: How is the Prophet’s religion presented in the passage?
questions.answer: As a religion full of strong and shining truths.

questions.question: What surprising group is said to confirm the Prophet’s greatness too?
questions.answer: His enemies.

questions.question: Why is it meaningful that enemies are mentioned as witnesses too?
questions.answer: Because it shows the evidence was strong enough for even opponents to notice.

questions.question: What else in his religion is described as a strong proof, besides miracles?
questions.answer: Its many bright and certain truths.

questions.question: What do the Companions add to the proof in this passage?
questions.answer: Their agreement supports and confirms his message.

questions.question: What can we learn from the fact that even enemies confirmed some of his qualities?
questions.answer: That his goodness was so obvious that even opponents could not deny it.

questions.question: What sentence in the passage gives the central statement of faith?
questions.answer: The declaration that there is no god but Allah.

questions.question: Whose testimony is presented as a major proof for this truth?
questions.answer: The testimony of Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What role does the Qur’an play in the argument of the passage?
questions.answer: It is one of the great signs supporting the Prophet’s truthfulness.

questions.question: What four things connected to the Prophet are listed as signs of his greatness?
questions.answer: The power of his Qur’an, the spread of his religion, his many virtues, and his lofty character.

questions.question: What two personal features of the Prophet are named as proof?
questions.answer: His many perfections and his elevated character.

questions.question: What kind of special signs are mentioned as strong proofs from the Prophet?
questions.answer: Many clear miracles.

questions.question: What do the many truths in his religion show?
questions.answer: They show that his message is bright, certain, and reliable.

questions.question: Name the third group that supports the Prophet’s witness.
questions.answer: The scholars of his community.

questions.question: Why are miracles important in this passage?
questions.answer: They are strong signs that support the Prophet’s message.

questions.question: In this passage, what truth about Allah is being proven?
questions.answer: That Allah exists and that He is One.

questions.question: What is the Prophet helping people understand about Allah’s unity?
questions.answer: He helps people understand that Allah’s oneness is true and certain.

questions.question: Who is described as a witness to this truth about Allah?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Prophet’s religion that supports his mission?
questions.answer: It is wide in reach and full of strong truths.

questions.question: How does the passage say even opponents help support the truth about the Prophet?
questions.answer: Even his enemies admitted his greatness.

questions.question: Does the passage rely on only one proof for the Prophet’s message, or many proofs?
questions.answer: Many proofs.
